summary: Iteration 2 focused on the 4 new features + 2 tweaks (auth, migration, mood, multi-workouts, weekly recap, Sunday-week). Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed (14 regression + 11 new). New coverage: register/login/me/logout, duplicate=409, wrong password=401, invalid Google session=401 (POST /api/auth/session), anonymous→account data migration via deviceUserId, dual auth on /api/day, /api/calendar, /api/search, /api/insights, /api/weekly-recap (Bearer AND userId query), missing identifier=400, mood persistence in entry+calendar+insights, workouts=[Cardio,Weights] persisted as array with insights.workoutBreakdown counting both and search returning page 5, weekly-recap window starts on Sunday (Sep 6, 2026 verified) with 7-day moodsByDay, wins pulled from dailyGoals+weekly.wentWell, highlightQuote, currentStreak. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): mood picker is Step 1/13 with 5 emoji faces (Rough/Low/Okay/Good/Great, testIDs mood-1..5), workout step (Page 5 / Step 6) header says 'Select all that apply' and multi-select works (Cardio + Weights both highlighted). Auth screen (create-account mode via auth-toggle-mode) registers new account and returns to Settings showing account name, email, and Sign out button; toggling to sign-in mode also works. Settings has account section (sign-in-btn / sign-out-btn), reminder switch (reminder-switch), and displays 'Reminders fire on an installed build, not in the Expo Go preview' warning correctly (expected on web). Weekly Recap screen renders card with streak, entries count, 7 mood dots for Sun-Sat, week label 'Sep 6, 2026 – Sep 12, 2026'; recap-next is disabled (pointer-events:none, opacity 0.4) at offset 0 and becomes enabled after tapping recap-prev (which moves to Aug 30 – Sep 5). No console errors, no red screens, no deprecated Expo packages detected.

issues: Reminder time controls (hour-up/hour-down/time-display) render only when the switch is enabled and OS permission is granted. On web, permission is denied so the time-display never appears — this is expected and the UI correctly shows the 'Notifications are turned off. Enable them in your device settings' banner. No action needed unless team wants a web-only fallback.

critical_code_review_comments: Auth endpoints correctly return session_token + user_public, use bcrypt via passlib CryptContext, and apply a timing-safe DUMMY_HASH when the email is unknown — good.
migrate_anonymous handles collisions per collection (deletes device duplicates for dates already present in the account) and merges profile.signupDate to the earliest — good.
Sunday week math (server.py:520) uses `(ref.weekday() + 1) % 7` — verified: Sep 6, 2026 is a Sunday and returns Sep 6→Sep 12 for offset=0, Aug 30→Sep 5 for offset=1.

server.py:497-499 still reads legacy `workout` singular alongside the new `workouts` array in the insights aggregation. This is fine for backward-compat with any old entries but the DayEntry Pydantic model no longer exposes `workout`, so new writes will only populate `workouts`. Consider a one-time migration or remove the legacy branch once you're confident no old docs remain.
flow.tsx is now 582 lines — still under the 700-line threshold. Mood step is correctly step 0 (Step 1 of 13) and workout chips toggle within a state array. Good.

server.py `get_account_id` correctly treats expired sessions as anonymous (returns None); combined with require_id logic, protected endpoints return 400 rather than 401 when no userId is provided either — that matches the anonymous-friendly design.
